verdict.rationale: Cline shows every edit as a diff you can review, modify or revert in VS Code and JetBrains, and Kanban adds diff review with inline comments. It can also run tests, react to their output, apply linter-aware fixes and review piped `git diff` output, all with checkpoints and one-click undo. Community users mention reviewing its diffs, but the evidence is mostly first-party. Missing for 10: an explicit pre-merge or PR gating workflow tied to check results, and independent hands-on corroboration of the checks side.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging
